data.overview: On the way back to his ancestral home, a good-natured young traveler falls for a woman whose family has sworn vengeance against his own. Their courtship turns a feud-bound household into a sequence of narrow escapes, mistaken intentions, and unlikely acts of kindness.
data.tagline: Some family traditions are hard to survive.
data.title: A Most Dangerous Welcome
